ui.Banner_ReadOnly: Read-only — jobs that could change the vehicle are blocked.
ui.Banner_Simulation: Simulation — write-class jobs are permitted because there is no vehicle to affect.
ui.Setup_F1Hint: Press F1 on any field for help.
ui.Browser_OriginalText: Original text from the ECU description file
ui.Browser_SelectEcuPrompt: Choose an ECU above to see the jobs it offers.
ui.Sgbd_Variant_Desc: One specific ECU. Its jobs can usually be browsed with no vehicle connected.
ui.Sgbd_Group_Desc: A family of ECUs. Opening it asks the vehicle which variant is fitted, so it needs a car connected — and then offers that variant's full job list.
ui.Sgbd_RequiresConnection_Desc: Requires an active vehicle connection: group files identify the fitted ECU by asking the vehicle, so they cannot be opened over a simulation. Connect through a K+DCAN cable, ENET or an ELM327 adapter to use this.
ui.Browser_NoResultsYet: Not run yet. Results appear here and are kept per job.
ui.Browser_NoDescription: This ECU description file documents no description for the job.
ui.SysResult_JOBSTATUS: Status of job processing — empty or OKAY means success
ui.SysResult_UBATTCURRENT: Battery voltage now, in mV (-1 = not measured)
ui.SysResult_UBATTHISTORY: Lowest battery voltage seen, in mV (-1 = not measured)
ui.SysResult_IGNITIONCURRENT: Ignition voltage now, in mV (-1 = not measured)
ui.SysResult_IGNITIONHISTORY: Lowest ignition voltage seen, in mV (-1 = not measured)
ui.SysResult_FAMILIE: ECU family the description file belongs to
ui.SysResult_GRUPPE: Group file, when one was loaded
ui.JobHelp_OfSgbd: Job of the `{0}` ECU description file.
ui.JobHelp_ReadOnlyNote: BimmerStudio is currently read-only, so this job cannot be run against a vehicle. The Run button stays disabled for anything that could change the car. It can still be run against a simulation.
ui.JobHelp_UnknownNote: The name did not match any known pattern. Unrecognised jobs are treated as writes rather than assumed safe, so this may be a perfectly ordinary read that simply uses unusual naming — check the description above.
ui.JobHelp_WhatFileSays: What the ECU description file says
ui.JobHelp_NoDescription: This SGBD carries no description for the job. That is common: the documentation blocks are optional and many files omit them.
ui.JobHelp_NoResults: The description file does not list the results this job returns.
ui.JobHelp_NamesNote: Job names are German protocol identifiers defined by the ECU description file, not by BimmerStudio, so they are always shown exactly as the SGBD declares them.
ui.JobNote_IDENT: Reads ECU identification: part number, hardware and software versions, and coding index.
ui.JobNote_IDENTIFIKATION: Reads ECU identification. On a group file this is what resolves which variant is fitted.
ui.JobNote_FS_LESEN: Reads the fault memory. Each stored fault code comes back as its own result set.
ui.JobNote_FS_LOESCHEN: Clears the fault memory. This destroys diagnostic evidence, so read the faults first.
ui.JobNote_IS_LESEN: Reads the info (shadow) memory on older ECUs.
ui.JobNote_STATUS_LESEN: UDS: reads measurement values by data identifier (DID).
ui.JobNote_STEUERN: Actuates a function on the ECU. Moves real hardware.
ui.JobNote_STEUERN_IO: UDS: drives an output directly, for actuator testing.
ui.JobNote_STEUERN_ROUTINE: UDS: starts an ECU-internal routine such as an adaptation or reset.
ui.JobNote_INITIALISIERUNG: Opens communication with the ECU. Many SGBDs run this automatically.
ui.JobNote_AIF_LESEN: Reads the workshop info field, which records previous service writes.
ui.JobNote_C_FG_LESEN: Reads the chassis number (VIN) from a coding-capable ECU.
ui.JobNote_SG_CODIEREN: The standard coding job. Writes coding data to the ECU.
ui.Safety_Read_Desc: Reads data from the ECU. Safe.
ui.Safety_CommInit_Desc: Opens communication with the ECU. Changes nothing.
ui.Safety_MemoryClear_Desc: Erases stored data such as fault memory.
ui.Safety_Actuator_Desc: Drives a physical output on the vehicle.
ui.Safety_Coding_Desc: Writes coding data to the ECU.
ui.Safety_Flash_Desc: Reprograms ECU firmware. Can render the ECU unusable.
ui.Safety_Unknown_Desc: Cannot be classified, so it is treated as a write.
ui.Status_FilesFound: {0} ECU description files and {1} group files found.
ui.Status_NoFiles: No .prg files here. Point at the Ecu folder of an EDIABAS or SP-Daten install.
ui.Blocked_ReadOnly: {0} is classified as {1}. {2} BimmerStudio is read-only, so it will not run against a vehicle. Press F1 for details.
